name: IT team · DECISION NEEDED (management): give the team a Docker-capable host, or accept M1 evidence without a running product
description:
This is a decision card, not a work card. It owns the one open question that holds the whole milestone sequence.

STATE (2026-11-27, verified against HEAD 9f655ee0)
- M1 (b9aaf03c) is NO-GO and re-forecast to 2026-12-02. The 21 Nov demo slot is six days past.
- M2 (299d12ce) is onhold behind M1, re-forecast to 2026-12-04.
- M3 (140668fe) wakes 2026-11-30 and sits on the same stack.
- No stack has ever been observed running: `/api/health` = connection refused (Errno 111), `/` = connection refused (Errno 111).
- The recorded-walkthrough fallback (def4ce38) has no artefact, because there is nothing to record.

WHAT IS NOT BROKEN (so the decision is not about engineering effort)
- demo/up.sh parses correctly: --list-providers (:153), --ref (:154-156), usage_providers() (:66-86), resolve_image() (:91-111), DEFAULT_TAG=latest (:28).
- An executable no-Docker test exists: demo/tests/test_up.sh, 26 TAP checks, registered in .codx/qa_policy.json as suite `demo`.
- The blocker is environmental: no reachable Docker daemon on the shift/rehearsal host.

OPTIONS
A (recommended) — provide a host or runner with a working Docker daemon. Cost: hours of work, unblocks M1 and M2. Risk: low.
B — accept M1 evidence as the shell-test transcript plus the recorded NO-GO. Cost: zero. Consequence: management never sees a running product; M2 stays undemoable.
C — drop M1 and start at M3 (efforts in the UI). Not recommended: M3 runs on the same stack, so it inherits the same blocker.

DECIDE BY: 2026-11-30 (the day b9aaf03c wakes to re-forecast). Without a decision the sequence silently slips another week.

DO: post the chosen option as a comment on b9aaf03c and move this card to done. Do not start engineering work from this card.
